title: Security Preparation Charges for Staged Endpoint Units by Microsoft 365 Plan
content:
The security preparation charge per unit of a Hardware Procurement staged re-quote, the re-quote of a cancelled Standard Endpoint Order line onto a Staged Endpoint Order, follows the client's Microsoft 365 plans, an E5 plan deciding when the client holds both an E5 plan and a Premium or E3 plan:

- **nothing** for a client holding an E5 plan whose active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement covers Microsoft 365 tenant administration, Stratton Bay then pushing its Defender for Endpoint Plan 2 onboarding by policy;
- **8.00 USD** for any other client holding an E5 plan or a Premium or E3 plan, whose Defender onboarding package the bench applies to each unit;
- **15.00 USD** for every other client, whose units the bench hardens by hand.

The client's Microsoft 365 plan is read once from its Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscriptions whose status is active: it holds an E5 plan when it has an active Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) subscription, and a Premium or E3 plan when it has an active Microsoft 365 Business Premium or Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) subscription; a subscription in any other status gives it neither.

Whether the agreement covers Microsoft 365 tenant administration is read from the coverage of the client's ClearPath agreement whose status is active.

## Truth table

| E5 plan | Premium or E3 plan | Active ClearPath agreement covering Microsoft 365 tenant administration | Charge per unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | Yes | nothing |
| Yes | either | No, or no active agreement | 8.00 |
| No | Yes | Yes | 8.00 |
| No | Yes | No, or no active agreement | 8.00 |
| No | No | any | 15.00 |

### Illustration (hypothetical figures)

For 12 units the charge is nothing, 96.00 or 180.00 respectively.
